content.text:
I've submitted index 42 (Ca 0.20, Fe 0.38, Mn 0.42) as the best composition. It gave the highest photocurrent of the three merit measurements, 1.1×10⁻⁷ A.

| Index | Ca / Fe / Mn | Photocurrent |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | 0.14 / 0.70 / 0.16 | 0 A |
| 15 | 0.18 / 0.45 / 0.36 | 2×10⁻⁸ A |
| 42 | 0.20 / 0.38 / 0.42 | 1.1×10⁻⁷ A |

Photocurrent went up as iron dropped and manganese rose. I only had three measurements, so I spent them following that trend. The last one, index 42, was my own pick rather than the GP model's top suggestion, which was index 96.

This may not be the best composition in the library. The trend was still rising at the last point, and I didn't test the region with more manganese (above about 0.45) or the calcium-rich area. I also used none of the 5 XRD measurements, so there's no phase identification behind the result.
